description: This file defines an interface 'IImbalanceToleranceRule' related to placement and balancing rules within Orleans' repartitioning logic, specifically focusing on tolerances for imbalance between silo pairs in the cluster.

classes.name: IImbalanceToleranceRule
classes.description: Interface representing a rule that controls the degree of imbalance between the number of grain activations exchanged between silos.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the specified imbalance value satisfies the rule.
